# Operations Performance and Efficiency Monitoring

This document details critical operational objectives and monitoring requirements:

*   Monitor teller performance on a quarterly basis.
*   Optimize customer wait times based on audit findings.
*   Optimize cash flow in alignment with Strategy 2026.
*   Enhance branch efficiency as recommended by audit reports.
